title: SPO Killings: J&K Congress Seeks BJP MLA’s Apology

ai.summary: Congress workers in Srinagar protested police blocking their march against BJP MLA Shagun Parihar for allegedly making mosque announcements before SPO killings, demanding an FIR and apology from her.

facts.claim: Congress workers in Srinagar protested police blocking their march against BJP MLA Shagun Parihar for allegedly making mosque announcements before SPO killings
facts.quote: Srinagar- Police on Tuesday foiled a protest by the Jammu and Kashmir Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC) against the alleged attempts by the BJP to disturb communal harmony in the Union territory.
